messages:
Maya (sec-eng): Quick heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild across hosted runtime and Dedicated pools. Found a couple stale packages and a potential KMS env var exposure in an old init script. Planning window Wed 10:00-12:00 PT. Who can help own parts of this?

Sam (runtime): +1. Rolling rebuild with a canary on one pool sounds safest. :thinking: I can own runtime validation.

Jen (infra): Scope? which images exactly and do we need RBAC changes for KMS access?

Maya (sec-eng): Targets: redwood/runtime-base:2024-12 and redwood/worker-base:2024-11. Changes: bump glibc and openssl, apply CIS docker hardening (drop CAPs, no-new-privileges), and remove the legacy init script that exported KMS creds. KMS: nodes will need kms:Decrypt for a new key alias. Also we must ensure audit logging captures KMS:Decrypt and registry pulls. Proposed plan: 1) build images with SBOM + attestation, 2) push to staging registry, 3) run vuln scan + QA, 4) canary deploy, 5) monitor audit logs & metrics, 6) full rollout.

Alex (sre): Important: CloudTrail (or equivalent) must log KMS API calls and retention should be >= 90 days for compliance. Add a metric for kms:Decrypt failures and an alarm. Also plan for fast rollback if any perf regressions.

security-bot: Automated scan: CVE-2025-12345 detected in redwood/runtime-base:2024-12 — openssl v1.1.1k — SEVERITY: HIGH. Recommended remediation: upgrade to 1.1.1t or migrate to openssl 3.x. See https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-12345

Sam (runtime): Good catch. Openssl upgrade may affect native extensions and our BPF-based tracing — I need to run the compatibility matrix. I'll add tests against runtime e2e harness.

Jen (infra): Current node role: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/redwood-node. Proposal: add a narrowly scoped policy with kms:Decrypt on alias/redwood-rebuild-2025. Will open a terraform PR and include a migration plan. We should feature-flag the new key usage.

Maya (sec-eng): Also require SBOM and SLSA attestation attached to the registry manifest. Build pipeline should emit sbom.json and cosign the image. Example snippet for the Dockerfile and labels to include in the build step:
```Dockerfile
FROM debian:12-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl ca-certificates 
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision=\"$GIT_SHA\"
```
And build step: `buildctl build --output type=image,name=registry/redwood/runtime-base:2025-01,push=true ...`

Sam (runtime): For runtime security: enable seccomp and readonly root fs where possible. Some sidecars need write access — I'll enumerate which ones and propose minimal tmpfs mounts.

Alex (sre): IR playbook note: if canary shows increased decrypt errors or a spike in 5xxs, auto-rollback should trigger and ops-bot will create an incident and tag @oncall. Also capture last successful image digest in the rollback action.

Jen (infra): I will open the terraform PR, add the kms policy module, tag it breaking-change and request reviews from @Maya and @Sam. Also will include the IAM migration runbook (how to attach to nodes without downtime).

Maya (sec-eng): Timeline suggestion: land infra PR by Tue EOD, land image builds Wed AM, run scans Wed 08:00-09:30, canary Wed 10:00-12:00, full rollout Thu. Objections?

Sam (runtime): Need a test matrix for openssl changes — I'll own compatibility tests and update the e2e CI to include the new image. Expect results by Wed 07:00. :eyes:

Alex (sre): I'll add CloudWatch/Datadog dashboards for KMS API calls, image-pull latency, and a log filter for KMS errors. Will share links in this thread when ready.

Jen (infra): PR created: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/pull/987 — terraform module and kms policy. PTAL @Maya @Sam.

Maya (sec-eng): ack, will review. Also add a check in the deploy pipeline to fail if SBOM or attestation missing.

ops-bot: Maintenance window created: \"base-image-rebuild-2025-01\" Wed 10:00-12:00 PT — notifications sent to #eng-runtime and #incidents.

Sam (runtime): Quick question: do we rotate the KMS key at the same time or create a new alias? Rotating in-place could invalidate existing encrypted data.

Jen (infra): We'll create a new customer-managed key and attach alias/redwood-rebuild-2025. Rotate later once we confirm no ciphertext depends on it. Migration notes are in the PR.

Maya (sec-eng): One more: vuln triage owner for the build -> @Sam will triage runtime libs, @Jen infra libs, and I'll own policy and audit checks.

Alex (sre): If anything goes wrong during canary, immediate actions: rollback, collect diagnostics (dmesg, container logs, KMS request IDs), and tag incident severity. I can prepare a small runbook snippet for that.

Jen (infra): Adding tests for iam policy binding to node groups in the PR pipeline so we don't surprise clusters.

Maya (sec-eng): Thanks all. I'll write a short checklist and paste it here. :thumbsup:

Maya (sec-eng): CHECKLIST:
- Build images with SBOM + cosign attestation
- Run vuln scan & triage (owners assigned)
- Land infra PR for kms policy (narrow scope)
- Deploy to staging, run compatibility tests
- Canary Wed 10:00 on a single region/pool
- Monitor KMS logs + metrics, rollback on alarm
- Post-rollout: audit log export and compliance report

Sam (runtime): noted, will update the test board.

Jen (infra): merging infra PR after approvals, schedule terraform apply in a safe window.

Alex (sre): I'll post dashboards and the rollback runbook link here when done.

Maya (sec-eng): Final: tagging this thread for the incident playbook and compliance artifacts. If anyone sees anything unexpected in the scans, ping me directly. :wave:
